prompt: Who brought pieces from Pompeii and Herculaneum to Brazil?

options.text: Empress Teresa Cristina, born in Naples

explanation: Teresa Cristina, born in Naples, arrived in 1843 with pieces that became the National Museum’s collection.

prompt: What happened to the collection in the 2018 National Museum fire?

options.text: It was hit, but some pieces were recovered
It survived intact in another building
It had been returned to Italy beforehand

explanation: The pieces were on display when the museum burned; items from the collection turned up in the recovery.

prompt: What happened to the fresco “Dragon and Two Dolphins”?

options.text: It was found in fragments and restored in Italy
It was destroyed without a trace

explanation: The fresco, from the Temple of Isis, was found in pieces and restored with a foundation in Turin.
